stats.notes: Fall 2023 first-years from the 2023-24 CDS, the newest edition readable as text: the 2024-25 and 2025-26 CDS PDFs are on a Google Drive link (the 2025-26 one asks for a sign-in; the 2024-25 one has numbers that cannot be extracted as text), so they were not used. CDS C1 residency table: in-state 2,873 applied / 2,650 admitted / 421 enrolled, out-of-state 898 / 783 / 66, international 518 / 370 / 16; total 4,289 / 3,803 / 503. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 as printed; average GPA is printed to one decimal (3.6). SAT/ACT percentiles, percent submitting scores and the C7 factor checkboxes could not be extracted as text, so they are left out. College Navigator fall 2024 (newer): 5,175 applicants, 87% admitted, 9% of admitted enrolled; undergraduate enrollment 1,954 and student-faculty ratio 10:1 are from College Navigator fall 2024. Saint Mary's is test-optional.

cds_test_policy.notes: The first-year admissions page says Saint Mary's will not require an SAT or ACT score. CDS 2023-24 C8 says: 'Saint Mary's has a Test Optional Policy.'

cost.notes: Saint Mary's own 2026-27 cost of attendance for a full-time, on-campus, non-nursing undergraduate: tuition $61,416 (12-18 units per semester) + fees $636 (student body $216, student enhancement $320, student experience $100) + food and housing $18,900 + books $1,304 + personal expenses $3,970 and transportation $1,386 (other_usd $5,356) = $87,612 as printed. Nursing (BSN) tuition is $76,770, total $102,330. The tuition_usd figure is the sticker price before merit aid. CDS 2023-24 H6 (aid year 2022-23): 64 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $51,482 (total $3,294,877); the policy checkboxes are not readable as text.
